candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations 503, order /v1/orders 502, and gateway /v1/checkout 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not admitted; whether the timeout originates in redis itself vs inventory client is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) propagating inventory 503 -> order 502 -> gateway 502, matching the ~2s checkout durations. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Order metrics show postgres healthy, isolating redis as the failing dependency.
